q: How much CO2 does a solar dryer save in agro processing?
title: CO2 saved by a solar dryer
short: Whatever fuel or electricity it replaces, times that fuel's emission factor. If a solar dryer replaces 1,000 litres of diesel a year, it saves about 2.7 tonnes of CO2. Measure the fuel used before and after so the saving can be shown.
audience: Spice, fruit, fish and grain processors considering solar drying

ol: Record fuel or electricity used for drying before the change.
Record what is still used after, for backup or finishing.
Multiply the difference by the factor: 2.68 kg CO2 per litre of diesel, 0.710 kg per kWh of grid power.

p: Illustrative only: a unit using 1,000 litres of diesel a year that cuts this to 0 saves 1,000 times 2.68, about 2.7 tonnes of CO2. Replace with your own records.
Solar dryers often need backup heat in monsoon months. Count only the fuel actually avoided, month by month.
